title: Resurrected Old Browser Game using Astra
author: Final-Block-5436
selftext:
Back in the 2000s there was a browser game called Trukz. It was a text based trucking simulation that was mainly a click to advance an hour while saving for upgrades, newer trucks etc. It was a multiplayer game where players could create companies, bid on contracts with said companies, and build routes for their members to maximize profit. It died a long time ago, but had been nagging at me for quite some time, and then in stepped Astra. 

I was able to have Astra scrape some old archives for the basics of how the game worked (as my memory is not that good). After building a basic game using Sites and getting it to a good place I felt was good enough for others to play, I migrated it to a domain.

I have absolutely no development experience (truck driver of 12 years), but am pretty happy with how it turned out. Trying to drum up a player base now, but the AI nature of development has turned some away. 

I feel like Astra really knocked it out of the park with it, and even if I'm the only one to stick with it, it exists again.

Wasn't entirely sure which flair to use as this isn't commercial at all. There are no pay to win aspects (nor will there ever be), and no ads on the site. 

[www.longhaulgame.com](http://www.longhaulgame.com)
